queries.sql: SELECT `vendor`.*, `location`.`location_name`, `vendor_rate`.`vendor_rate`, `vendor_rate`.`from_date` FROM `vendor` LEFT JOIN `location` ON `location`.`location_id` = `vendor`.`location` LEFT JOIN (SELECT `vr1`.`vendor_id`, `vr1`.`vendor_rate`, `vr1`.`from_date` FROM `vendor_rate` as `vr1` INNER JOIN (SELECT vendor_id, MAX(from_date) as max_date FROM vendor_rate GROUP BY vendor_id) as vr2 ON vr1.vendor_id = vr2.vendor_id AND vr1.from_date = vr2.max_date) as vendor_rate ON `vendor_rate`.`vendor_id` = `vendor`.`id` GROUP BY `vendor`.`id`
